propositions: Every newly certified plan review must emit exactly one deterministic signed pin per direct child and per normalized prerequisite relation, encoding the target canonical ticket ID, role (child or prerequisite), and target material_fingerprint as 16-hex.

PlanRelationSnapshot must preload all ticket states store-wide including archived entries, then collect outgoing depends_on and inbound blocks without active-source filtering to discover arbitrary blockers, with related_material as a deterministic sorted tuple of role-ID-fingerprint records.

Unreadable or unresolvable targets must raise PlanRelationSnapshotError with one of exactly six named reason enums (missing-target, ambiguous-reference, malformed-reference, reducer-error, canonical-id-mismatch, store-read-failure) and return unsigned INDETERMINATE before any LLM call without traceback.

tracker_head_sha must verify clean repository state via git status --porcelain and git ls-files -u, then return 40-lowercase-hex HEAD or raise store-read-failure for any git/IO/path/subprocess failure.

All plan-review signing paths (sign_plan_review, refresh_attestation, resign_plan_review) must call collect_plan_relation_snapshot and pass the related_material to build_manifest(..., pins=...), emitting complete pin sets deterministically in every path.

Legacy manifests without pins must remain parseable and authenticatable without reconstruction, with new readers ignoring only pin lines for field interpretation while verifying the complete DSSE manifest.
